responsibility: Defines assembler-side support macros and ELF note emission for Intel CET on x86 targets. This header does not provide C intrinsics; instead it supplies the _CET_ENDBR function-entry macro and emits .note.gnu.property metadata describing IBT and SHSTK enablement for ELF objects when assembling with CET options, making it the target-property and assembly-annotation companion to runtime CET intrinsics.
